title: East lane: the blocks between the fountain plaza and the dorms
caption: The first of the island's neighbour blocks (work issue #139): the lane past the fountain plaza on to the dorm street, built as backdrop in the plaza's palette. Day 1 doesn't walk it; you see it from the plaza's east exit and on the island map (M).

sections.title: The plaza's east exit, before and after
sections.caption: Where the lawn was bare, an office block's front now closes the view: its door, a bike rack and a walk crossing the lane between the avenue's zelkovas.

images.caption: After work: lamps and lit windows

sections.title: The island map
sections.caption: The plaza's tile now runs east to the dorm courtyard, so the gap between them is gone.

sections.title: Close up (Eric placed where the player can't go)
sections.caption: The lane's jog, the pocket park with its gravel square, and the office block with the north street behind.

images.caption: The cross walk and the jog
The office block and the north street

sections.title: Follow-up (#162): the training centre up the cross walk
sections.caption: The block at the top of the cross walk is the company's new-staff training centre, with a sign on its canopy (けんしゅう NEW STAFF TRAINING). Eric can now walk the lane on past the cross walk and up it to the door. Its menu says Go in; the door is locked, and one line says why. The same line plays in the morning and after work, when its windows stay dark.
